intent_snapshot.goal: Implement Slice S8 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md: obtain real installed-Antigravity evidence for Enrollment, QA, Review, verifier observation, continuation and completion; probe and implement or explicitly reject P8/Skill integration; then update certification disclosures and close #451/#469 with evidence.

acceptance.assertion: Per D10 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md (source: BR-REQ-7): live probes establish whether PreInvocation can inject active-task guidance and whether a model-callable Skill tool exists. Positive: supported injection uses the shared active-task notice and model Skill self-entry is denied without a live phase. Negative: unsupported capabilities remain unsupported with observed reasons and no fictitious Hook matcher. Bound: probe payloads/results and any implementation are recorded in the live report and packaged tests. Agreed seams: tests/antigravity-assurance-conformance.test.ts, tests/antigravity-host-package.test.ts.

Per D11 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md (source: BR-REQ-8): the evidence validator accepts only a current report naming Host version, plugin digest, Task ID, exact commands, native gates, verifier correlation, continuation observations and a final done projection. Positive: a complete successful real run passes and justifies closing #451/#469 with evidence links. Negative: absent agy/report, stale plugin digest, skipped phase, failed command or non-done projection fails; a skip is never a pass. Bound: BR-SCN-4 is performed manually on the real Host and fixture evidence alone cannot certify it. Agreed seam: tests/antigravity-live-certification.test.ts reading docs/reports/antigravity-live-certification.md.

Per D11 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md (source: BR-REQ-8): only after the live evidence passes do the capability table and Antigravity README claim the corresponding certified cells/lifecycle, and all generated outputs and docs are current. Positive: final declarations match evidence and checks pass. Negative: an unsupported/failed probe cannot be promoted. Bound: P9 Pi remains unsupported and no other Host is claimed certified by this Antigravity run. Agreed seam: package/doc generation plus TypeScript.

attestations.summary: Provenance verified: review commit 7adb2d08 has single parent 8fe3b959 and tree d3a78c8f. AC1: PreInvocation now injects the shared activeTaskNotice only at turn start (invocationNum 0), skips re-recording on follow-ups, adds no Skill matcher, and is tested at both agreed seams. AC2: the validator rejects an absent agy or report, a stale bundle digest, any skipped or failed phase, a failed command, and a non-done projection, with tests at the agreed seam. AC3: the capability table, README and both bundles are promoted consistently, P5 stays guard-only and P9 stays unsupported. Mirrored runtime files have identical blob OIDs. The agy argv reorder (--print last) is applied to Review and Lane spawn and tested. Blast radius: medium. Load-bearing paths are runtime/antigravity/capability.ts, lane_guard.ts PreInvocation, cli_review.ts and lane_supervisor.ts agy argv, and the two dist bundles.

advisory_findings.summary: The validator checks BR-SCN-4 audit proof and task-record SHAs only when the file exists. A missing file is silently skipped instead of failing.

evidence.trigger: A report whose br_scn_4.audit_records point at nonexistent .imm/audit paths, with qa_passed and review_approved set to true → validateLiveCertificationReport returns ok with no error. The real report's paths are tracked in the review commit, so the current report is unaffected.

advisory_findings.summary: In the P8 probe, pre_invocation_supported and invocation_num_turn_start=0 are hardcoded, not observed. skill_tool_present comes from the model's own list of declared tools, not from Host metadata.

evidence.trigger: runP8LiveProbe on an agy build that sends invocationNum>0 at turn start → the report still records invocation_num_turn_start=0 because the value is a literal. If the model leaves Skill out of its declared_tools answer, skill_tool_present=false is recorded without independent proof.

findings.summary: runLiveCertification hard-codes final_projection {lifecycle:'done',artifact_state:'frozen',terminal_proof_verified:true} and the enrollment/qa/review/completion phases as 'passed'. The report names task antigravity-live-certification as done, but nothing observes that run. The phase evidence comes from three earlier, unrelated tasks' audit proofs. So the validator accepts a final done projection that was invented, not measured.

evidence.trigger: scripts/verify-antigravity-live.ts --run while task antigravity-live-certification is still active:frozen in Review → docs/reports/antigravity-live-certification.md records task_id=antigravity-live-certification with final_projection lifecycle=done and terminal_proof_verified=true, and every phase passed. No TaskRecord or terminal proof for this task is read. validateLiveCertificationReport only checks the literal fields, so the run passes and the report is used to justify closing #451/#469. Separately, validateLiveCertificationReport compares audit_records SHA only when the proof file exists, so a missing terminal-proof.json passes silently.

findings.summary: The capability table, capability.ts and the dist bundle promote P2, P4, P6 and P7 to 'Live-certified on agy 1.5.8', but no live probe covers them. The native-gate and 7-Stop continuation probes call the bundled hook directly with node and synthetic payloads, with no agy involved. No probe in the script exercises Lane Executor spawn at all (P6).

evidence.trigger: runNativeGateAndContinuationProbes runs callBundledHook (process.execPath mcp-server.mjs --hook) with hand-built PreToolUse/Stop payloads. runLiveCertification has no Lane Executor step. Yet plugins/immune-brain/runtime/antigravity/capability.ts sets P2/P4/P6/P7 level 'certified' with evidence 'Live-certified on agy 1.5.8 ... Lane Executor execution', and docs/reference/host-capability.md says the same. Result: ports with no real-Host probe are promoted from conformance-only to certified.

findings.summary: When agy produces no async result event, runVerifierLiveProbe injects a synthetic PostToolUse itself (stepIdx 99, read_file) and still records post_tool_immediate_return and async_result_resolved as true. The resolution in the report may therefore come from the script, not from the Host.

evidence.trigger: Real agy --print run where the Host never sends a follow-up PostToolUse → the script calls callBundledHook with a fabricated PostToolUse payload, a 'result' event appears, and the report records post_tool_immediate_return=true, async_result_resolved=true and a passed verifier_observation phase. The report does not record that the fallback was used.
